headline: Civil Service Commission sets open search for personnel director

meeting.summary: The Civil Service Commission voted to fill the personnel services director job through open recruitment and formed a working group to plan hiring.
meeting.recap: The commission put off old business to focus on hiring a new personnel services director.[[0:02:45]] It voted unanimously to make the deputy director acting director if no new director is chosen by the current director's retirement.[[0:12:42]] With four ayes, the commission voted to fill the job through open recruitment.[[0:21:29]] With four ayes, it voted to advertise through the department's usual methods and a County press release.[[0:35:06]] With four ayes, it voted to accept applications by a special email address or by mail.[[0:47:44]] With four ayes, it voted to remove identifying details from applications before the first review.[[0:49:17]] One person testified in support of an open, competitive hiring process.[[1:04:54]] A motion was made to form a small working group, called a TIG, made up of the vice chair and Commissioner Suzuki.[[1:24:40]] Its tasks include setting the application process, timelines, a scoring rubric and interview stages.[[1:25:28]] The group will send three top candidates to the full commission for interviews.[[1:26:22]] The commission voted to approve the working group.[[1:27:00]] The commission's lawyer said recent court decisions favor open sessions over closed sessions.[[1:28:33]] The lawyer will check if interviews can follow the group's report at the same meeting, or recommend a special meeting.[[1:29:24]]
decided: The commission approved naming the deputy director as acting director if no new director is chosen by the current director's retirement date.
The commission approved using open recruitment to find the new director.
The commission approved advertising through the department's usual methods and a County press release that can be sent to professional organizations.
The commission approved receiving applications by a designated email address or by mail, in care of a designee in the Department of Management.
The commission approved having identifying information removed from applications, with corporation counsel's support, before the first review.
meeting.next: The commission's lawyer will research whether interviews can happen right after the working group's presentation, and if not, will recommend a special meeting for interviews. The lawyer will look into which parts of the hiring process can be done in closed session and which must be done in open session.
